welcome.title: Your pipeline, in your pocket
welcome.body: See hot leads, reply faster, and stay on top of SMS and email — built for agents on the go.
welcome.sign_in_link: Already have an account? Sign in

value.slide1_body: Inbox prioritizes urgent threads so you can respond when it matters — before the deal goes cold.
value.slide2_body: Open any lead to see recent SMS and email, AI signals, and quick actions to call or message.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Get alerted for hot leads and new inbound messages. You can change this anytime in system settings.

login.title: Welcome back
login.body: Sign in with the same email and password you use on CloseBoss web.
login.token_body: Paste a JWT only for troubleshooting or if email sign-in is unavailable.
login.missing_api_url: Missing API URL — set EXPO_PUBLIC_LEADSMART_API_URL in .env or app config.
login.remember_hint: When off, you'll be signed out after you fully close the app.
login.error_generic: Sign-in failed. Check your connection and try again.

back.hint: Returns to the previous onboarding step
